title: Substrings of Size Three with Distinct Characters
summary: Given a string s , count the number of substrings of length three that contain no repeated characters, where each occurrence of such a substring should be counted separately.
statement: Given a string s , count the number of substrings of length three that contain no repeated characters, where each occurrence of such a substring should be counted separately.
constraints: Count occurrences separately, even when two valid substrings have the same text.
hints: Only a window of exactly three characters matters.
Maintain character counts while adding the new character and removing the character three positions back.
Once the window has length three, count it exactly when the map has three keys.
The map represents precisely the current length-three window, so three keys is equivalent to all three characters being distinct.
editorial: The map represents precisely the current length-three window, so three keys is equivalent to all three characters being distinct.

tests.explanation: Only the first window, xyz, contains three distinct characters.
The valid windows are abc, bca, cab, and the later abc, for four occurrences.
